title: Efficacy and safety of antibody-drug conjugates in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer after tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

context: Forest plot of pooled ORR across the nine included studies. Pooled ORR = 44.7% (95% CI 36.7%–52.9%; I² = 84.4%). Primary outcome: pooled objective response rate The pooled ORR across all nine studies was 44.7% (95% CI 36.7%–52.9%), based on the random-effects model ( Figure 2 ).
